output_list.reason: This integer overflow vulnerability occurs when the return value of a function call (e.g., balanceOf) is used as the argument for arithmetic operations, potentially causing truncated values due to limitations in the EVM stack.

This vulnerability exists when the return value of a function call (e.g., balanceOf) is used as the argument in an arithmetic operation, potentially causing truncated values due to the limited capacity of the EVM stack.
